# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 12

**1** The disciples said to Jesus: "We know that you will leave [бол] us. Who will become great [ноч] over us?"

**2** Jesus said to them: "Wherever you have come [ні], you will go [вок] to James [іакоvос] the Just [дікаіос], for whose sake heaven [тпе] and earth [кахе] came into being."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *бол*: to leave, depart, go out
- *ноч*: great, large; the disciples ask about succession
- *іакоvос*: James; the Greek form of Hebrew יַעֲקֹב (Ya'aqov)
- *дікаіос*: Greek loan-word, "just/righteous" — James's title; known as "James the Just" in early Christian tradition
- "For whose sake heaven and earth came into being" — cosmic significance attributed to James; hyperbolic honor formula
- This saying is striking: Jesus names James (his brother) as the succession authority, not Peter (as in Matt 16:18)
- Cf. Gospel of the Hebrews fragment on James; Eusebius on James the Just

---
